section.content: The invention discloses a biological gene analysis device, which relates to the technical field of biological gene analysis and comprises a placement seat, wherein an analysis box is fixedly connected to the upper surface of the placement seat, a conveying mechanism is arranged in the analysis box, a pushing mechanism is arranged in the middle of the upper surface of the analysis box, a water collecting cylinder is fixedly connected to one side of the upper surface of the analysis box, and a connecting pipe communicated with the water collecting cylinder is fixedly connected to one side of the water collecting cylinder. According to the invention, through the arrangement of the structures such as the connecting pipe, the extrusion rod, the driving mechanism and the like, after the analysis mechanism analyzes the biological genes, the conveying motor is started, so that the moving plate drives the sample test tube to move, the driving toothed plate moves, the connecting gear drives the driving rod to rotate, the linkage gear drives the adjusting toothed plate to move downwards, the lower pressing plate is driven to press the extrusion rod downwards, the extrusion rod discharges water in the extrusion barrel into the cleaning tube, and the interior of the straw is cleaned.

本发明公开了一种生物基因分析装置，涉及生物基因分析技术领域，包括放置座，所述放置座的上表面固定连接有分析盒，所述分析盒的内部安装有输送机构，所述分析盒上表面的中部安装有推动机构，所述分析盒上表面的一侧固定连接有集水筒，所述集水筒的一侧固定连接有与集水筒相连通的连接管。本发明通过连接管、挤压杆与驱动机构等结构的设置，实现了当分析机构对生物基因分析后，启动输送电机，使得移动板带动样本试管移动，使得驱动齿板移动，从而使得连接齿轮带动驱动杆转动，使得联动齿轮带动调节齿板向下移动，从而带动了下压板将挤压杆向下压动，使得挤压杆将挤压筒内部的水排入清洗管的内部，对吸管内部进行清洗。

Biological gene analysis deviceTechnical Field

The invention belongs to the technical field of biological gene analysis, and particularly relates to a biological gene analysis device.

Background

A gene is the entire nucleotide sequence required to produce a single polypeptide chain or functional RNA. Genes support the basic architecture and performance of life. All information of life race, blood group, inoculation, growth, apoptosis and other processes is stored. The interdependence of environment and inheritance deducts important physiological processes such as life reproduction, cell division, protein synthesis and the like. All life phenomena such as growth, senility, illness, aging, death and the like of organisms are related to genes. It is also an intrinsic factor in determining life health. Thus, genes have dual attributes, materiality and informativeness.

In gene sampling analysis of an organism, it is necessary to use a biological gene analysis apparatus.

Through retrieving, chinese patent No. CN218036880U discloses a bioinformatics gene information analysis device, including analytical equipment body and the ejecting component of setting inside analytical equipment body, the upper end of ejecting component is provided with analytical equipment, and analytical equipment body is including freezing chamber case and hinge the push door in freezing chamber case one side, and the spacing long piece of analytical equipment body inner chamber fixedly connected with, and spacing long piece is provided with two sets of, ejecting component include with two sets of spacing long piece sliding connection's slip cavity, this kind of setting makes sample test tube get and puts the process efficiency high, and avoids sample test tube to take place to rock, and the circumstances that causes liquid clear in the sample test tube to spill or bump and break takes place, hoisting device's practicality.

However, the above patent has the following problems:

Though through mutually supporting of structures such as motor and first lead screw, avoid the sample tube to take place to rock, and cause the clear or the circumstances that bumps and break up of liquid in the sample tube to take place, and through the setting of structures such as worm wheel and worm, make the device carry out the automation to the sample in the sample tube and absorb and carry out information analysis work, it is comparatively convenient to use, hoisting device's work efficiency, but biological gene analysis device is after carrying out analysis to the sample, can't wash the straw, thereby probably lead to the straw when absorbing other samples, cause the secondary sample to mix the back again and carry out analysis, thereby influence biological gene sample analysis's data, biological gene sample analysis's accuracy has been reduced, so this, provide a biological gene analysis device.

Disclosure of Invention

The invention aims to provide a biological gene analysis device, which solves the problems that the biological gene analysis device can not clean a straw after analyzing a sample in the prior biological gene analysis device, so that the straw possibly mixes two samples and analyzes the mixed samples when sucking other samples, thereby influencing the data of biological gene sample analysis.

In order to solve the technical problems, the invention is realized by the following technical scheme:

The invention relates to a biological gene analysis device which comprises a placement seat, wherein an analysis box is fixedly connected to the upper surface of the placement seat, a conveying mechanism is arranged in the analysis box, a pushing mechanism is arranged in the middle of the upper surface of the analysis box, a water collecting cylinder is fixedly connected to one side of the upper surface of the analysis box, a connecting pipe communicated with the water collecting cylinder is fixedly connected to one side of the water collecting cylinder, a first one-way valve is fixedly connected to the inside of the connecting pipe, an extrusion cylinder fixedly connected with the analysis box is fixedly connected to one end of the connecting pipe, an extrusion rod is connected to the inside of the extrusion cylinder in a sliding manner, elastic rods fixedly connected to the inside of the extrusion cylinder are attached to two sides of the lower surface of the extrusion rod, a drain pipe communicated with the extrusion cylinder is fixedly connected to the lower surface of the drain pipe, three water pipes communicated with the drain pipe are fixedly connected to the surface of the drain pipe, a path array is fixedly connected to the surface of each water pipe, and a plurality of cleaning pipes are jointly provided with the analysis mechanism.

Further, pushing mechanism includes the cavity section of thick bamboo through bolt fixed connection in analysis box upper surface middle part, the inside fixedly connected with electric putter of cavity section of thick bamboo, electric putter's one end runs through the analysis box and with analysis box fixed connection, electric putter's output fixedly connected with connection pad.

Further, the analysis mechanism comprises electric water absorbers which are respectively and fixedly connected to one end of a corresponding cleaning pipe and are communicated with the cleaning pipe, a plurality of second one-way valves are fixedly connected to the inside of the cleaning pipe, a plurality of biological gene analyzers which are fixedly connected with electric push rods are fixedly connected to one ends of the electric water absorbers together, and suction pipes which are communicated with the electric water absorbers are fixedly connected to the other ends of the electric water absorbers.

Further, the conveying mechanism comprises two conveying motors which are respectively and fixedly connected to two edges on one side of the analysis box, the output ends of the conveying motors penetrate through threaded rods fixedly connected with the analysis box, the surfaces of the threaded rods are connected with moving plates in a threaded mode, the two sides of the lower surface of each moving plate are respectively attached to stabilizing plates fixedly connected to the two sides of the inner bottom wall of the analysis box, and driving mechanisms are arranged on the surfaces of the moving plates.

Further, the upper surface of movable plate is route array fixedly connected with backup pad, the surface of backup pad is route array slip grafting and has sample test tube, the upper surface of movable plate is rectangular array and has seted up the jack groove, a plurality of sample test tube respectively with a plurality of jack groove is corresponding, the internally mounted in jack groove has fixture.

Further, the fixture is including being annular array fixed connection in the inside clamping spring of spliced groove, a plurality of clamping spring average divide into two sets of, two sets of clamping spring's one end is all fixedly connected with grip block jointly, two the grip block is all corresponding with the sample test tube.

Further, the driving mechanism comprises a driving toothed plate fixedly connected to one side of the upper surface of the moving plate, a connecting gear is meshed with the surface of the driving toothed plate, a driving rod which is rotatably connected to the inner wall of the analysis box through a bearing seat is fixedly connected to the surface of the connecting gear, and a linkage gear is fixedly connected to the surface of the driving rod.

Further, the surface engagement of linkage gear has the regulation pinion rack, one side of adjusting the pinion rack runs through analysis box fixedly connected with and extrudees the lower extreme board that the pole corresponds, the inside wall of analysis box is route array fixedly connected with and adjusts the limiting plate of pinion rack sliding connection.

The invention has the following beneficial effects:

1. Through the arrangement of structures such as a conveying mechanism, a water collecting cylinder, a connecting pipe, an extrusion rod, a driving mechanism and the like, the realization that after the analysis mechanism analyzes biological genes, a conveying motor is started, a moving plate drives a sample test tube to move, a driving toothed plate moves, a connecting gear drives a driving rod to rotate, a linkage gear drives an adjusting toothed plate to move downwards, a lower pressing plate is driven to press the extrusion rod downwards, the extrusion rod discharges water in the extrusion cylinder into a cleaning pipe, the cleaning pipe is arranged, the suction pipe is cleaned, the moving plate is driven to reciprocate, the extrusion rod is automatically reset through the elasticity of an elastic rod, and therefore the water in the water collecting tank is sucked into the extrusion cylinder through the arrangement of the connecting pipe, and the cleaning pipe can be repeatedly cleaned by automatically adding water;

2. Through the arrangement of structures such as a water collection cylinder, a connecting pipe, a pushing mechanism, a conveying mechanism, an analysis mechanism and the like, the biological gene sample is placed in the sample test tube, a conveying motor is started, a movable plate drives a supporting plate to move towards the inside of the analysis box, so that the sample test tube is driven to move to the position right below a suction pipe, the sample test tube is clamped through the arrangement of a clamping mechanism, the sample test tube is more stable when moving, meanwhile, an electric push rod is started after the sample test tube moves to a proper position, the electric water absorber sucks the sample in the sample test tube into the biological gene analyzer through the suction pipe, the biological gene sample is analyzed, and the biological gene analyzer can automatically extract the sample in the test tube to obtain analysis information, so that the biological gene analyzer is more convenient to use, and the working efficiency is improved;

of course, it is not necessary for any one product to practice the invention to achieve all of the advantages set forth above at the same time.

Detailed Description

Reference will now be made in detail to exemplary embodiments, examples of which are illustrated in the accompanying drawings. When the following description refers to the accompanying drawings, the same numbers in different drawings refer to the same or similar elements, unless otherwise indicated. The implementations described in the following exemplary examples are not representative of all implementations consistent with the present disclosure. Rather, they are merely examples of apparatus consistent with some aspects of the disclosure as detailed in the accompanying claims.

The technical solutions in the embodiments of the present invention will be clearly and completely described below with reference to the accompanying drawings in the embodiments of the present invention. All other embodiments, which can be made by those skilled in the art based on the embodiments of the invention without making any inventive effort, are intended to be within the scope of the invention.

Specifically, when the biological gene analysis device is used, a biological gene sample is placed in a sample test tube 21, a conveying motor 17 is started, the output end of the conveying motor drives a threaded rod 18 to rotate, so that a moving plate 19 moves towards the inside of an analysis box 2, when the moving plate 19 moves, a driving toothed plate 25 is synchronously driven to move, a connecting gear 26 rotates, so that a driving rod 27 rotates in the inside of the analysis box 2, a linkage gear 28 is driven to synchronously rotate, a regulating toothed plate 29 synchronously moves upwards, a lower pressing plate 30 synchronously moves upwards, and the extruding rod 7 slides upwards in the inside of an extruding cylinder 6 through the elasticity of an elastic rod 8, so that water in the inside of a water collecting cylinder 3 is sucked into the inside of the extruding cylinder 6 through a connecting pipe 4;

After the moving plate 19 moves to a proper position, a plurality of sample test tubes 21 are vertical to the corresponding straws 16, then the electric push rod 13 is started, the output end of the electric push rod drives the biological gene analyzer 15 to move downwards, so that the electric water absorber 14 and the straws 16 synchronously move downwards, the straws 16 are inserted into the sample test tubes 21, the electric water absorber 14 is started, biological gene samples in the sample test tubes 21 are sucked into the biological gene analyzer 15 through the straws 16, and the biological gene samples are analyzed;

After the analysis is finished, the electric push rod 13 is started, the biological gene analyzer 15 is reset, thereby the suction pipe 16 is separated from the sample test tube 21, afterwards, the conveying motor 17 is started, the threaded rod 18 is reversely rotated, the moving plate 19 is driven to move out of the analysis box 2, when the moving plate 19 is moved, the driving toothed plate 25 is synchronously moved, thereby the connecting gear 26 is driven to drive the driving rod 27 to rotate, the linkage gear 28 is driven to drive the adjusting toothed plate 29 to move downwards, the lower pressing plate 30 is driven to move downwards, the extrusion rod 7 slides in the extrusion barrel 6, water in the extrusion barrel 6 is discharged into the water supply pipe 10 through the drain pipe 9, water enters the cleaning pipe 11, the suction pipe 16 is cleaned through the water in the cleaning pipe 11, the suction pipe 16 is enabled to reduce internal impurities when other biological gene samples are sucked, the accuracy of biological gene analysis data is improved, the water in the water collection barrel 3 can only enter the extrusion barrel 6 through the connecting pipe 4, the water collection barrel 6 can not enter the interior through the extrusion barrel 6, and the electric water can not enter the cleaning pipe 11 through the electric water absorber 14 through the electric water absorber 31, and the water can not enter the cleaning pipe 11 through the electric water absorber 14.
